text:
anna: Standup check-in — kernel/batching/KV perf.

What I did:
- Landed microbatch allocator change (PR #4315), added per-batcher wait_time metric

Blockers:
- Intermittent KV evict race on canary; reproducer flaky
- CI test failing for new metric export

Today:
- Finish repro and add extra logging
- Pair with @sara on CAS fix if needed
- Run a 1h perf sweep across batch windows (1/2/5/10ms)

cc @mike @sara

mike: Nice. quick q — did the allocator change affect slot fairness? any delta on p95? :bar_chart:

anna: Local synthetic bench: p95 ~6% better. Canary: 0-2% variance. Running longer sweeps now. Logged config: `allocator: slot_assign=round_robin->adaptive`

sara: I saw the evict race in last night's canary logs. dumping the stack helped isolate timing. I have a small patch adding a CAS in the evict path. Can open PR and pair.

anna: Yes please open a PR and tag me. Also need kernel to expose `batcher.active_slots` metric — I have a draft but tests failing in CI.

josh: CI note: `TestKVHotEvict` flaky timeout. Increasing timeouts hides it. Repro locally with:
```
./scripts/run_evict_repro --seed 42 --concurrency 8
```

liam: perf-bot ran nightly sweep; heatmap shows spikes at p98 for seq=512 with batching window 5ms. Artifacts: https://bench.company/ark/2441234567 (artifact)

perf-bot: automated: nightly-bench finished: batch_win=5ms, p95_tokens=12.7ms, p99=46.2ms. Artifact uploaded.

mike: Re: batching window — can we try adaptive sizing by load to avoid the p98 spike?

anna: Plan:
1) Repro race (today)
2) Land CAS fix from @sara
3) Add `batcher.active_slots` metric and wire to console
4) Schedule 2h bench sweep across windows and post artifacts

@liam can you run the sweep after lunch? thanks.

liam: I can run it at ~14:00 UTC and post artifacts + short summary. happy to pair for 30m after run.

sara: PR opened: #4322 - CAS in evict path, added test. small change. please review @anna @josh

josh: Reviewing now. LGTM modulo one nit comment.

anna: Thanks. will land after CI passes. small ask: don't enable adaptive batcher in canary until evict is stable.

mike: :thumbsup: ping me if you want the canary flipped.

anna: Will post final bench results and next steps here. Thx everyone! :rocket:
